CustomMetadata.label: Duplicate rules block, not only alert

values.value: An alert is easy to click away, so duplicates keep coming in, especially through imports and integrations that never see the alert. Set the action to Block where you can, and for objects where blocking is too strict, report on alerted duplicates and merge them regularly.
Duplicate rules on the main donor objects block duplicates, or alerts are reported and followed up.
Do your duplicate rules for Contact, Account and Lead block new duplicates, rather than only showing an alert? Check Setup > Duplicate Rules > Action on create and edit.
